set.intro_body: From rooftop craft beers to global cuisine by the pool — dining at The Chancery Pavilion is a journey of its own.
Chancery Hotels has been a part of Bangalore's hospitality landscape since 2000. We're always looking for people who share our love of service, craft and ceremony.

set.description: A contemporary venue ideal for private functions, workshops and social celebrations, comfortably accommodating up to 250 guests.
A well-appointed hall suitable for business meetings, training sessions and intimate private events, with a capacity of up to 90 guests.
Designed for executive meetings and discussions, the Board Room offers a professional, well-appointed environment for corporate sessions of up to 50 guests.

match.question: What general amenities are available at The Chancery Pavilion?

set.answer: The Chancery Pavilion offers three dining experiences: award-winning open-air dining and craft beer at Alchemy; round-the-clock dining at Ithaca, the 24/7 coffee shop overlooking the pool; and snacks and light bites at The Lounge, open from 9:00 AM to 10:30 PM. Guests also have access to a fitness centre open from 6:00 am to 9:00 pm, a swimming pool open from 6:00 am to 6:00 pm, 24-hour in-room dining, daily turndown service, on-site laundry, a business centre, valet parking, wake-up calls, and Wi-Fi and LAN connectivity.
